records.text: Before his 2025 podcast circuit, Benjamin Netanyahu had not sat down with an American podcaster since a 2023 interview with Lex Fridman, for which Fridman flew to Netanyahu's office in Israel.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Prior to this PR blitz, Bibi (Benjamin Netanyahu) had actually not sat down with an American podcaster in years, years. ... Since 2023, to be precise, when he sat down with Lex Friedman, and I should make it clear that he made Lex Friedman fly to his office in Israel to conduct that interview.

verification.notes: The absolute claim is contradicted by Dr. Phil interviewing Netanyahu for his podcast in May 2024, after the July 2023 Lex Fridman interview and before the 2025 circuit. This is false regardless of the narrower claim about where the Dr. Phil interview was recorded.

sources.title: The Exclusive Interview with Benjamin Netanyahu
sources.relevance: Dr. Phil podcast episode published May 14, 2024 directly refutes the no-podcaster-since-2023 claim.

sources.title: Benjamin Netanyahu: Israel, Palestine, Power, Corruption, Hate, and Peace
sources.relevance: Primary episode page dates the Lex Fridman interview to July 12, 2023, establishing the comparison point.
